decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: The large defect with left-to-right shunt and step-up in oxygenation at the atrial level are diagnostic of an atrial septal defect. The right bundle-branch block is a secondary ECG finding, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Describes only an ECG conduction abnormality without addressing the underlying structural defect and hemodynamic evidence.
